csv_agency: State of Hawaii Dept of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Hawaii, Department of Transportation (HDOT), Design Branch is seeking qualified consultants to provide general structural engineering services for General Structural Engineering Services, Statewide, Project No. HWY-DB-SE26-01. Project Assignments will be in support of Federal-aid and/or State-funded projects being designed by the Design Branch, Department of Transportation. The CONTRACTOR shall provide general structural engineering services as specified on an as-required basis.

title: As-Needed General Structural Engineering Services
short_description: Statewide on-call structural engineering services for Hawaii DOT transportation design projects.
project_location: Honolulu, Hawaii, USA; statewide assignments in Hawaii
project_scope: On-call general structural engineering services for statewide Federal-aid and/or State-funded transportation projects designed by the Hawaii Department of Transportation Design Branch. The notice does not define specific structures, spans, quantities, or individual project sites. Contract duration is 60 months and assignments are to be issued on an as-required basis.
services: General structural engineering services on an as-needed basis for HDOT Design Branch projects; multidisciplinary support may involve structural engineering together with landscape architecture, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, land use planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style as-needed contract without defined technical scope or specific structures.
- Includes structural engineering, but no identifiable bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure opportunity.
- Multiple broad disciplines are listed, suggesting a general services contract rather than a focused structural design commission.
- sbp guidance indicates framework agreements without technical specification are generally not desired, especially when no concrete project is defined.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. Only a total construction cost of 10,000,000 USD and a 60-month as-needed contract are stated; no fee basis, percentage, or task-order volume is defined.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants are sought to provide general structural engineering services. The source does not specify detailed minimum references, number of comparable projects, licenses, or qualification thresholds.

notes: Project No. HWY-DB-SE26-01; Contract No. 541330. Target market is Streets/Highways. Category assigned based on transportation/highway context, but the exact structure types remain unspecified.
